errors.text_span: The chart is divided into 9 slices
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows 10 distinct slices, not 9. The description later lists all 10 categories, making this opening statement factually incorrect and inconsistent.
The slice for "Organizational Report" is a medium/dark purple. The description incorrectly assigns it the color "light purple", which actually corresponds to the "Organizational Website" slice.
The slice for "Event Posting" is a dark, reddish-brown (maroon) color, not pink. This is a significant misidentification of the color.

The color for the "Organizational Website" slice is light purple, not just "purple". This description is imprecise and confusing, especially since the color "light purple" was already incorrectly assigned to the "Organizational Report" slice.
